concepts.def: Skills that help you get and keep work
Doing what you said you would

walkthroughs.body_html:
Punctuality and reliability matter more than talent.

If you turn up on time and do what you promised, you're ahead of half the staff. ⏰

Almost every job needs teamwork:

  • Listen to others.
  • Share ideas.
  • Help when needed.
  • Don't take credit alone.

Great teams beat great solo stars.

Professionalism = behaving well at work:

  • Polite to everyone.
  • Tidy and presentable.
  • Confidential about company info.
  • Polite about colleagues even online. 📱

Bosses notice. So does the next employer.
